svg.title: Active-Active · Cluster mode · Three datacenters
svg.desc: Datacenters A, B and C have Service IDs 0, 1 and 2. Each accepts local reads and writes and has three matching shards, each with a Primary and a Replica. Each datacenter's Primaries feed its own replication proxy. Each proxy serves the matching-shard Primaries in both other datacenters. All three pairs replicate in both directions, with an independent Oplog stream for each direction and shard. Proxies do not connect to one another. Membership discovery is filtered by shard. All datacenters use the same slot layout.
svg.text: Three datacenters · Matching shards replicate across every datacenter pair
Gossip membership — shard-filtered; each shard forms its own mesh
Matching shards only: A with A, B with B, C with C — independent streams in both directions for all three datacenter pairs
Each Primary feeds its own datacenter's proxy (plain lines). Arrows show Oplog flow to peer Primaries; peers initiate the pulls.
All sites use the same shard count and slot layout. Up to 16 members per shard; Service IDs and slot ranges are illustrative.
